says: The step commit helper reports correctly formatted files as unformatted because pnpm refuses its temporary working folder.
proof: At head 55ae19989916bacf063c1e418f72869fe1891957, stepcommit.sh --commit-only tests 1122 with the watcher integration test and tests run row exited with not_formatted. Direct pnpm exec oxfmt --check over those files passed. Repeating the helper's formatter command from an equivalent temporary folder with its copied config and named files returned ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_NO_PACKAGE: No package found in this workspace. The installed package manager is pnpm 12.16.1. The helper invokes pnpm exec with cwd=tmp, which has no package manifest, and discards that diagnostic.
cost: A tests worker cannot publish its reviewable work through the required commit workflow, even when all formatter checks pass.
